acceptance.criterion: Checkout return alone never grants access; one customer cannot acquire duplicate active paid subscriptions through retries
acceptance.expected: Provider snapshot is authoritative for entitlement, never a client-supplied return; a customer holding any nonterminal subscription cannot start a second checkout, and duplicate nonterminal subscriptions reported by the provider fail closed rather than picking one
acceptance.observed: Checkout() blocks a second attempt while one nonterminal subscription exists and returns the same session on retry (TestCheckoutSurvivesRestartAndPreventsSecondPlan). ReconcileCustomer rejects two nonterminal subscriptions for one customer without granting access or corrupting the account's plan (TestReconcileRejectsDuplicateNonterminalSubscriptions, added this pass)

acceptance.criterion: Checkout completed before webhook then deletion cancels that subscription; open checkout cannot leave a live subscription after deletion closure is certified
acceptance.expected: CloseBillingAccount expires open checkout sessions, cancels every provider subscription including ones never observed locally, and only certifies closed after a re-list confirms none remain active; a resumed call after partial success stays idempotent
acceptance.observed: TestReconcileCustomerAndCloseBillingAccount confirms session expiry, subscription cancellation and the post-cancel recheck before CloseStatusClosed. TestCloseBillingAccountResumesAfterAlreadyClosedProviderState (added this pass) confirms a second call against already-terminal provider state, with a stale local checkout row left over as if a prior local commit never landed, still certifies closed and clears the stale row

acceptance.criterion: Stale checkout attempts are repaired account-scoped and auditable; late webhooks are idempotently acknowledged
acceptance.expected: Attempts older than 23h are resolved or fail closed with an audit_log entry; webhooks for a deleted account acknowledge without creating entitlement; duplicate event IDs are not refetched
acceptance.observed: Unchanged from the prior pass: reconcileOldCheckoutAttempt writes audit_log on repair; the deleted-account branch in Webhook acknowledges without a lookup error; TestWebhookReconcilesCurrentStateAndDeduplicates confirms a repeated event ID is not refetched from the provider

acceptance.criterion: Grace deadline is stable under delayed/replayed events, first observed past_due, missed activation, new invoice/renewal and delayed old failure after payment. Renewal opens a fresh allowance while retaining old-window accounting history
acceptance.expected: The 72h payment-failure grace anchors to an authoritative provider timestamp, never local processing time, so delayed delivery or a delayed reconcile cannot silently extend or misplace it; a renewal into a new unpaid period starts a fresh deadline while the closed window's accounting is retained, not overwritten in place
acceptance.observed: Corrected this pass: neither the Subscription nor the Invoice object carries a 'became past_due at' field (verified against docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions/object and docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/object for the pinned 2025-06-30.basil shape), so grace now anchors to Event.created for webhooks and to the subscription's own current_period_start for a bare reconcile snapshot -- both are provider-owned and stable under delay, unlike time.Now(). Replay/delay within an unchanged period preserves the stored deadline (TestWebhookReconcilesCurrentStateAndDeduplicates). First observation via a delayed reconcile with no prior local row ('missed activation') anchors to period start, confirmed already-expired rather than a fresh now-based window (TestReconcileCustomerAnchorsGraceToAuthoritativePeriodNotProcessingTime, new). A delayed webhook anchors to its own event.Created (TestWebhookGraceAnchoredToEventCreatedNotProcessingTime, new). A renewal into a new unpaid period opens a distinct fresh deadline and writes the closed window's status/period/grace to audit_log as subscription_window_closed before the row is overwritten (TestReconcileCustomerRenewalOpensFreshGraceAndRetainsOldWindow, new). A late/reordered failure event delivered after recovery cannot reopen grace because the handler always re-fetches current provider truth rather than trusting the event body's claimed status or age (TestWebhookLateFailureAfterPaymentDoesNotReopenGrace, new). The four new grace-anchoring tests were confirmed red against the pre-fix commit (parent of e7585dc) by temporarily swapping in that blob and rerunning them, then green after restoring the fix; the other two passed unchanged, since they cover already-correct behavior
